def: A private way from inside your VPC to an AWS service such as S3 or Secrets Manager, without going through the internet or a NAT gateway. A gateway endpoint is a route; an interface endpoint is a private address in your subnet.
A way to open a shell on a server from the AWS console, with no SSH key and no open inbound port. The server needs an IAM role and a route to Systems Manager.
A stateless firewall on a whole subnet. Unlike a security group, it can deny traffic, and replies need their own rule.
